verdict.rationale: Parsec's pricing page lists 'Virtual monitors' among its professional host features, so the product does document creating a virtual display. The evidence is a single bare feature-list mention, with no detail on how it behaves. missing for 10: documentation that virtual displays keep rendering on a headless host or when windows are covered, setup and limits of virtual monitor creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
